name: Employee Reimbursements
report_script:
def execute(filters=None):
    columns = [
        {"label": "Employee", "fieldname": "employee", "fieldtype": "Link", "options": "Employee"},
        {"label": "Employee Name", "fieldname": "employee_name", "fieldtype": "Data"},
        {"label": "Reimbursement Type", "fieldname": "reimbursement_type", "fieldtype": "Link", "options": "Reimbursement Types"},
        {"label": "Total Amount", "fieldname": "total_amount", "fieldtype": "Currency"},
    ]

    conditions = """
        status = 'Approved' AND docstatus = 1
    """
    params = []

    if filters.get("from_date"):
        conditions += " AND creation >= %s"
        params.append(filters["from_date"])

    if filters.get("to_date"):
        conditions += " AND creation <= %s"
        params.append(filters["to_date"])

    query = f"""
        SELECT 
            employee, 
            employee_name, 
            reimbursement_type, 
            SUM(total_amount) AS total_amount
        FROM `tabReimbursement`
        WHERE {conditions}
        GROUP BY employee, reimbursement_type
        ORDER BY employee
    """

    data = frappe.db.sql(query, tuple(params), as_dict=True)

    return columns, data
